svg.title: B20 / LUNAR RECLAIMER — Algal Rare-Earth Recovery engineering mission profile
svg.desc: B20, LUNAR RECLAIMER — Algal Rare-Earth Recovery. Original project: Rare Earth Metal Recovery from Waste Stream Using Algae. Session B: Earth & Environmental Engineering. Scientific question: Can a documented algal sorbent recover target rare-earth elements selectively and repeatedly from competing-ion waste streams? Testable hypothesis: Real-matrix competition and reuse losses will reduce performance relative to simple solutions; recovery feasibility depends on selectivity and product separation, not percent removal alone.. svg.text: Rare Earth Metal Recovery from Waste Stream Using Algae
No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Evaluate algal biomass as a selective sorbent for verified rare-earth
recovery from realistic wastewater, emphasizing recovered product and
lifecycle cost. A critical provenance correction: aluminum measurements
cannot demonstrate yttrium removal or recovery, so surrogate experiments
remain method-development evidence until actual target elements are
measured. Compare recovery, regeneration and residual waste as separate
Can a documented algal sorbent recover target rare-earth elements
selectively and repeatedly from competing-ion waste streams?
TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS / NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
Real-matrix competition and reuse losses will reduce performance relative to
simple solutions; recovery feasibility depends on selectivity and product
ICP-based target-element measurement or validated equivalent is needed.
Sorption, precipitation and uptake must be distinguished by mass balance.
Published sorbents and matrices do not establish performance of another
VALIDITY LIMITS / THE CLAIM STOPS HERE
Equilibrium fits may fail for complex speciation or solids. Product purity
and regeneration data are often sparse; apparent removal can produce
contaminated biomass rather than usable recovered material.
COUNTS OF RECORDS · NO COMPLETION SCORES
